newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Acos Villares to invest $140 mln.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Acos Villares to invest $140 mln.

text.p: Brazilian steel maker Acos Villares said it will invest $140 million next year to modernize its existing mills, cut production costs and raise productivity.
"We are in the middle of a restructuring process and our investments will start bearing fruits next year," Acos Villares President Jose Carlos Martins told analysts late Wednesday.
Martins said the company would post better results in 1997 due to an expected recovery of the country's truck sales and improvement of production processes as a result of the reestructuring.
In the first nine months of the year, Acos Villares posted inflation adjusted losses of 17.6 million reais ($17 million), with net revenues totalling 384.1 million reais ($371.5 million).
